doc: Extra objectives a mission can pursue. When a mission starts, three are drawn at random from those of its scenario and the team chooses which to go for; each one met adds its points and never takes any away. `check` says what the flight must do (kinds are read by scripts/flight/objectives.gd): `target_m`, `pole_m`, `shadow_edge_m` (distance in metres at touchdown, at most `max`), `touchdown_mps` (touchdown speed, at most `max`), `fuel_left` (share of the lander's fuel left, at least `min`), `contact_kept` (Earth in view through the whole descent), `tli_error` (share off the burn toward the Moon, at most `max`), `ascent_error_deg` (mean degrees off the guidance marker on the climb, at most `max`). `photo` is the picture the mission sends home when the objective is met. Ids are stable keys, never shown to players. Objectives with scenario `any_orbit` serve every mission that has no landing of its own: `ascent_fuel_left` (share of the last stage's fuel left in orbit, at least `min`), `science_frac` (science gathered over the mission's goal, at least `min`), `budget_reserve` (share of the budget left, at least `min`).

shadow_photo.name: Look into the dark
shadow_photo.desc: Land within 300 m of the edge of the permanent shadow and photograph the crater floor that has not seen the Sun for billions of years, the way ShadowCam does from orbit.
shadow_photo.simplified: The 300 m and the points are our game values; the photo is ShadowCam's real picture of Shackleton's floor.

rim_landing.name: Bullseye on the rim
rim_landing.desc: Touch down within 60 m of the target on Shackleton's sunlit rim, where the Sun shines almost all month long.
rim_landing.simplified: The 60 m and the points are our game values.

earth_contact.name: Never lose Earth
earth_contact.desc: Keep Earth in view of the antenna through the whole descent. From the pole Earth hangs low on the horizon, so a hill or the crater wall can hide it.
earth_contact.simplified: Earth's height above the horizon is fixed at 3 degrees in the game; it really wobbles a few degrees over the month. The hills that hide it are the real LOLA heights.

soft_touch.name: Feather touch
soft_touch.desc: Touch down slower than 1.5 m/s, gently enough not to spill a cup of coffee.
soft_touch.simplified: The 1.5 m/s is our game value. Touchdown speed and the slope under the legs are what decide a landing [S-apollo-gear].

fuel_hop.name: Fuel for a hop
fuel_hop.desc: Land with a third of the lander's fuel left. Chandrayaan-3's lander used its spare fuel to rise 40 cm and land again a little farther on.
fuel_hop.simplified: The share of fuel and the points are our game values.

pole_visit.name: The bottom of the world
pole_visit.desc: Touch down within 250 m of the geographic south pole, 90 degrees south, the spot every line of longitude meets.
pole_visit.simplified: The pole's place is where the LOLA map's projection puts it; the 250 m and the points are our game values.

true_burn.name: Bullseye burn
true_burn.desc: End the burn toward the Moon within 1 % of the speed it needs, so no correction is needed on the way.
true_burn.simplified: The 1 % and the points are our game values.

ride_marker.name: Ride the marker
ride_marker.desc: Fly the climb yourself and keep the rocket within 5 degrees of the guidance marker, on average, all the way to orbit.
ride_marker.simplified: The 5 degrees and the points are our game values.

fly_climb.name: Fly the climb yourself
fly_climb.desc: Take the stick for most of the climb and keep the needle within 6 degrees of the green marker on average, as a pilot does on a real launch.
fly_climb.simplified: The 6 degrees and the points are our game values.

fuel_spare.name: Reach orbit with fuel to spare
fuel_spare.desc: Arrive in orbit with at least 5 % of the last stage's fuel left: a clean climb wastes nothing.
fuel_spare.simplified: The 5 % and the points are our game values.

science_goal.name: Hit the science goal
science_goal.desc: Gather all the science points the mission asks for: enough power, a fast enough antenna and the right instruments.
science_goal.simplified: The points are our game values.

reserve.name: Keep a quarter of the budget
reserve.desc: Finish with at least 25 % of the budget left over, the reserve real agencies love to see.
reserve.simplified: The 25 % and the points are our game values; real missions keep 10 to 30 % for surprises.
